access: Known base and stage catalogue; short replay outputs with validated arithmetic enclosures. Nonlinear cases additionally use recipe-derived matrix norms, offsets and quartic coefficients to bound remainders; no claim that short probes alone identify arbitrary nonlinear maps.
complexity: N^2 training-stage probe executions. Subset computation O(N*2^N*d^2), suffix compositions O(d^3) each, factorial worst-case search; full factorial point-map baseline computed separately.
independence: Eight seed blocks reused across matched settings. Targets and pair decisions within a codebook are dependent. Digits uses one fixed underlying dataset.
nonlinear_analysis: Report all 256 nonlinear cases and all budget cells without selecting successful cells or changing thresholds.
primary_affine_goal: At least 90% full-history coverage at 1024 class-bound evaluations, zero wrong inferred pairs, zero invalid jobs; count all 256 affine targets.
seed_derivation: first four SHA256 bytes, big-endian, of chronotrace-structured-confirmation-v1:2026-09-12:{i}, i=0..7
